notes: - Fixed overlays bleeding across charts (TSLA series appearing on the AAPL chart): the chart layout — indicators, overlays, style — was saved under one GLOBAL key shared by every chart, while drawings were always correctly per-symbol. The layout store is now keyed by symbol, switching symbols reloads that symbol's own layout, and a one-time migration keeps your indicator setup while dropping overlays bound to a different symbol. **Compare remains the only cross-symbol mechanism**, as designed. A contract test now enforces the isolation.
